fieldValues.title: docs/schema/2.0/manifest.json and srsj-envelope.json cite RFC-026 R15, which RFC-026 does not define
fieldValues.summary: SliceExternalRef.relationType's description in both schema files reads '...NOT subject to RFC-005 definition-lookup in the slice archive (RFC-026 R15).' RFC-026's own .md defines conformance rules only up to [R14] (the relationType/RFC-005 rule IS [R14], word-for-word the same claim) -- there is no [R15] anywhere in rfcs/rfc-026-ext-slices-subset-export.md. Left uncorrected while folding srs#766, since it is a separate, unrelated off-by-one and not part of that issue's containerIndex/instanceIndex scope.
evidence: docs/schema/2.0/manifest.json:~391 and docs/schema/2.0/srsj-envelope.json:~416 both say '(RFC-026 R15)'
rfcs/rfc-026-ext-slices-subset-export.md's Conformance Rules section ends at [R14], which states the identical relationType/RFC-005 claim the schema attributes to R15
fieldValues.body: Likely a stale citation from an intermediate draft revision where this rule was numbered R15 before a renumbering left the schema comment unbumped. Fix is Door 3 (or a trivial citation correction, arguably Door 1 since it corrects a citation number rather than a normative rule) -- either way it needs its own issue rather than being folded into srs#766, whose scope is the containerIndex/instanceIndex retirement.
